interpretation: Typed reading over chains indexed by the natural numbers: if each member touches or is continuous with the next, some one thing is made of them all (242b26: ὥστʼ εἶναί τι ἐξ ἁπάντων ἕν). The -A reading states the same step for the hypothesised chain with atoms. The reading does not say whether the one thing is finite or infinite; 242b27-29 says this makes no difference.
